entry.title: When eating slows or food is thrown
entry.summary: The authors leave how much to eat to the baby. Throwing food may mean they are finished; it is a possibility to notice, not a certain explanation.
entry.cue: Your baby’s interest in the meal has changed.
detail: In the book’s division of responsibility, the adult offers the food and place, and the baby decides how much. The authors oppose pressing one more mouthful or distracting a baby into eating.
They describe asking whether the baby is done and helping end the meal when that fits what is happening.
